sources.extracted_facts: OFFLIMITS is an Indian performance footwear and athleisure brand positioned around accessible high performance. Canonical technology names include Advance Memory Foam, Athlite, Flexinit, Glovefit and Wiktech; Wiktech is described as supporting faster moisture evaporation. Voice is motivational, inclusive and value-conscious.

Live men's Gladiator page: knitted upper with KPU overlay, memory-foam insock, Phylon/TPR sole. Live Ethos page: Flyknit upper, super-soft EVA insock in specifications, Phylon/TPR sole; product copy describes steady grip/slip resistance and lightweight styling.
Live Gladiator For Her page: Flyknit upper, memory-foam insock, Phylon/TPR sole. Live Pulse X For Her page: mesh upper, PU-moulded insock, Phylon/TPR sole.

Live men's Snow and Sonic tracksuit pages list zip neck, full sleeves, 90% polyester/10% spandex and technology spelled 'Wicktech' on-page. Women's WMN PCT CNS Tracksuit lists hoodie, full sleeves, 100% polyester and 'Wicktech'. Women's Printed Insert Tights list mid-rise, 240 GSM, 90% polyester/10% spandex and 'Wicktech'. The draft uses canonical brand spelling Wiktech and does not imply collection-wide coverage.

The article should stay focused on what to wear; integrate OFFLIMITS products and documented features; make footwear the strongest section; follow challenge-to-top-to-bottom-to-shoe-to-layer-to-outfit-to-styling progression; reduce generic rain/commute/care advice; and finish with a persuasive brand-led CTA.
